text:
The Legend of Zelda 40th Anniversary Triforce Medley (Orchestral Version)
Enjoy this orchestral arrangement, specifically made for The Legend of Zelda 40th Anniversary. It's themed around Wisdom, Power, and Courage—the virtues of the Triforce—and includes a medley of various songs.

Plus, check out the official website for The Legend of Zelda 40th Anniversary! https://www.nintendo.com/us/explore/characters/zelda/
